name: matrixcharts
description: WebGL2 candlestick chart with a sequenced live candle feed.

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/write-dual-package-json.cjs && node --test tests/OHLCPyramid.test.cjs tests/Decorations.test.cjs tests/CandleFeed.test.cjs tests/FeedBoundary.test.cjs tests/StreamingIntegration.test.cjs tests/CandlestickLayout.test.cjs tests/Coordinates.test.cjs tests/Options.test.cjs tests/Panes.test.cjs tests/PriceScale.test.cjs tests/SessionScale.test.cjs tests/Overlays.test.cjs tests/PublicApi.test.cjs tests/ChartContainer.test.cjs
scripts.benchmark: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/write-dual-package-json.cjs && node benchmarks/sustained-feed.cjs
